_note: Classical yoga library. lib/yoga-engine.js reads detection_rule.type and either evaluates it declaratively or routes detection_rule.custom to a dedicated function. Sources: BPHS, Phaladeepika, Saravali, Jaimini Sutras. Do not modify detection rules without flagging the classical source.
_rule_types: kendra-from-moon | conjunction | planets-in-houses | planet-in-houses | dignity-in-kendra | moon-yoga | kartari | lord-in-houses | lord-association | custom

yogas.name: Dhana Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: lords connected only by distant aspect, one lord in dusthana
strength_assessment.medium: lords in mutual aspect or same house, neither debilitated
strength_assessment.strong: lords conjunct or in exchange, in own/exalted dignity, in kendra/trikona

yogas.effects: Wealth accumulation through the matters of the linked houses. Two or more of houses 1/2/5/9/11 lord-linked forms a money-generating combination.

yogas.name: Lakshmi Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: 9th lord strong but Lagna lord weak
strength_assessment.medium: 9th lord in own/exalted in kendra or trikona, Lagna lord reasonably placed
strength_assessment.strong: 9th lord exalted in kendra/trikona AND Lagna lord strong and well placed

yogas.effects: Lasting prosperity, fortune, reputation, grace. Wealth that endures.

yogas.name: Maha Lakshmi Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: Jupiter and Venus in the houses but afflicted
strength_assessment.medium: both unafflicted in 2/5/9
strength_assessment.strong: both in own/exalted in 2/5/9 with benefic support

yogas.effects: Abundance, luxury, financial grace.

yogas.name: Vasumati Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: only 2 benefics in upachaya, mildly placed
strength_assessment.medium: 2-3 benefics in upachaya houses
strength_assessment.strong: all 3 natural benefics in upachaya houses, dignified

yogas.effects: Wealth that compounds over time; self-made abundance.

yogas.name: Chandra-Mangal Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: Moon-Mars only by distant aspect
strength_assessment.medium: Moon-Mars mutual aspect or in 7th from each other
strength_assessment.strong: Moon-Mars conjunct or in exchange

yogas.effects: Earnings through enterprise and drive; can also bring emotional harshness or volatility.

yogas.name: Adhi Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: one benefic in 6/7/8 from Moon
strength_assessment.medium: two benefics in 6/7/8 from Moon
strength_assessment.strong: all three natural benefics in 6/7/8 from Moon, dignified

yogas.effects: Leadership, success, abundance, good health, well-being.

yogas.name: Raja Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: kendra-trikona lords linked only by aspect, one weak
strength_assessment.medium: kendra and trikona lords associated, both reasonably placed
strength_assessment.strong: kendra-trikona lords conjunct or in exchange, in own/exalted dignity

yogas.effects: Authority, leadership, status, power, recognition.

yogas.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: 9th and 10th lords linked by aspect only
strength_assessment.medium: 9th and 10th lords associated, well placed
strength_assessment.strong: 9th and 10th lords conjunct or in exchange in kendra/trikona

yogas.effects: Major career success with name and fame; the single most powerful career raja yoga.

yogas.name: Vipreet Raja Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: one dusthana lord in another dusthana but aspected by benefics (dilutes the yoga)
strength_assessment.medium: dusthana lords (6/8/12) placed in dusthanas, unaspected by benefics
strength_assessment.strong: dusthana lords interlinked in dusthanas, conjunct, no benefic aspect

yogas.effects: Paradoxical rise — adversity converts to success. Harsha (6th lord in 6/8/12), Sarala (8th lord), Vimala (12th lord).
negation_conditions: dusthana lord strongly aspected by benefics

yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: one cancellation condition met
strength_assessment.medium: two cancellation conditions met
strength_assessment.strong: multiple cancellations + debilitated planet in kendra from Lagna or Moon

yogas.effects: A debilitated planet whose debilitation is cancelled — late-blooming exceptional results in that planet's significations.
negation_conditions: no cancellation condition met (then it stays a plain debilitation)

yogas.name: Ruchaka Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: Mars in own sign in kendra but aspected by malefics
strength_assessment.medium: Mars in own sign in a kendra
strength_assessment.strong: Mars exalted in a kendra with benefic aspect

yogas.effects: Courage, leadership, physical strength, success in technical/uniformed/competitive fields.

yogas.name: Bhadra Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: Mercury in own sign in kendra but afflicted
strength_assessment.medium: Mercury in own sign in a kendra
strength_assessment.strong: Mercury exalted in a kendra with benefic aspect

yogas.effects: Intelligence, scholarship, eloquence, success in business and communication.

yogas.name: Hamsa Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: Jupiter in own sign in kendra but afflicted
strength_assessment.medium: Jupiter in own sign in a kendra
strength_assessment.strong: Jupiter exalted in a kendra with benefic aspect

yogas.effects: Wisdom, righteousness, respect, philosophical depth, dignified character.

yogas.name: Malavya Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: Venus in own sign in kendra but afflicted
strength_assessment.medium: Venus in own sign in a kendra
strength_assessment.strong: Venus exalted in a kendra with benefic aspect

yogas.effects: Luxury, comfort, beauty, vehicles, refined tastes, harmonious life.

yogas.name: Sasa Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: Saturn in own sign in kendra but afflicted
strength_assessment.medium: Saturn in own sign in a kendra
strength_assessment.strong: Saturn exalted in a kendra with benefic aspect

yogas.effects: Authority through persistence, careers in management, judiciary, mining, labour, large organisations.

yogas.name: Gajakesari Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: Jupiter or Moon in dusthana, or afflicted by Rahu/Ketu/Saturn
strength_assessment.medium: Jupiter in kendra from Moon, both unafflicted
strength_assessment.strong: Jupiter exalted/own in kendra from Moon, with benefic aspect

yogas.effects: Intelligence, wisdom, prosperity, fame, dignified character, respect in society.

yogas.name: Budhaditya Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: Sun and Mercury conjunct but Mercury deeply combust
strength_assessment.medium: Sun and Mercury in same house, Mercury not deeply combust
strength_assessment.strong: Sun-Mercury in own/exalted sign, Mercury beyond combustion orb

yogas.effects: Intelligence, communication skill, analytical ability, success in intellectual professions.

yogas.name: Saraswati Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: the three benefics in the houses but some afflicted
strength_assessment.medium: Mercury, Jupiter, Venus all in the specified houses, unafflicted
strength_assessment.strong: all three dignified, with Jupiter in own/exalted

yogas.effects: Exceptional learning, scholarship, eloquence, mastery of knowledge and the arts.
negation_conditions: any of the three debilitated or combust

yogas.name: Sunapha Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: one planet in 2nd from Moon, afflicted
strength_assessment.medium: benefic in 2nd from Moon
strength_assessment.strong: strong benefic in 2nd from Moon

yogas.effects: Self-earned wealth, intelligence, good reputation.

yogas.name: Anapha Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: one planet in 12th from Moon, afflicted
strength_assessment.medium: benefic in 12th from Moon
strength_assessment.strong: strong benefic in 12th from Moon

yogas.effects: Good health, well-being, comforts, a pleasant disposition.

yogas.name: Durudhura Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: planets on both sides of Moon but afflicted
strength_assessment.medium: planets in 2nd and 12th from Moon
strength_assessment.strong: benefics on both sides of Moon

yogas.effects: Abundance, generosity, comforts, all-round support.

yogas.name: Kemadruma Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: Moon isolated but in own/exalted sign or aspected by a benefic (partial cancellation)
strength_assessment.medium: Moon with no planets in 2nd/12th and no kendra support
strength_assessment.strong: Moon isolated, in dusthana, no benefic aspect, no cancellation

yogas.effects: Isolation, instability, struggle, emotional loneliness; results fluctuate. Often cancelled — check for planets in kendra from Moon or Lagna.

yogas.name: Daridra Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: 11th lord in dusthana but aspected by a benefic
strength_assessment.medium: 11th lord in 6/8/12 unaspected by benefics
strength_assessment.strong: 11th lord debilitated in dusthana, afflicted

yogas.effects: Financial struggle, blocked income, recurring shortfalls. Often softened by Vipreet Raja Yoga if other dusthana lords interlink.
negation_conditions: 11th lord in own/exalted sign in the dusthana

yogas.name: Mangal Dosha

strength_assessment.weak: Mars in a dosha house from only one reference point, or strong cancellation present
strength_assessment.medium: Mars in a dosha house from two reference points
strength_assessment.strong: Mars in a dosha house from all three reference points, no cancellation

yogas.effects: Friction, delay, or discord in marriage. Heavily over-diagnosed in popular practice — always check cancellations and never alarm the user.
negation_conditions: Mars in own/exalted sign (Aries, Scorpio, Capricorn)
Mars conjunct or aspected by Jupiter

yogas.name: Kaal Sarp Dosha

strength_assessment.weak: partial — most but not all 7 planets hemmed; or a planet exactly on a node
strength_assessment.medium: all 7 planets between the Rahu-Ketu axis
strength_assessment.strong: all 7 tightly hemmed, no planet near the nodes, malefics prominent

yogas.effects: Energy stagnation, delays, a sense of being blocked; results come in sudden bursts. Note: not a classical BPHS dosha — present it cautiously and never as a curse.
negation_conditions: any planet outside the Rahu-Ketu arc (then it is only partial or absent)

yogas.name: Pitru Dosha

strength_assessment.weak: Sun mildly associated with a node, 9th lightly afflicted
strength_assessment.medium: Sun conjunct Rahu/Ketu, or 9th house clearly afflicted
strength_assessment.strong: Sun tightly conjunct a node AND 9th house heavily afflicted

yogas.effects: Ancestral (paternal-line) karmic burden; can touch progeny, father relationship, fortune. Frame constructively, never as a curse.
negation_conditions: strong benefic aspect on Sun and the 9th house

yogas.name: Guru Chandala Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: Jupiter-Rahu only by aspect
strength_assessment.medium: Jupiter conjunct Rahu
strength_assessment.strong: Jupiter tightly conjunct Rahu, Jupiter weak

yogas.effects: Distortion of wisdom and judgment, unconventional beliefs, risk of scandal; also gives unorthodox brilliance. Not purely negative.
negation_conditions: Jupiter exalted or very strong (then it gives unconventional genius)

yogas.name: Angarak Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: Mars-Rahu only by aspect
strength_assessment.medium: Mars conjunct Rahu
strength_assessment.strong: Mars tightly conjunct Rahu in a dusthana or on Lagna

yogas.effects: Anger, impulsiveness, accident-proneness, sudden conflict. Channelled well, it gives fearless drive.

yogas.name: Vish Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: Saturn-Moon only by aspect
strength_assessment.medium: Saturn conjunct Moon
strength_assessment.strong: Saturn tightly conjunct a weak Moon in a dusthana

yogas.effects: Emotional heaviness, melancholy, chronic low mood, a serious disposition. Also gives depth and endurance.

yogas.name: Shapit Dosha

strength_assessment.weak: Saturn-Rahu only by aspect
strength_assessment.medium: Saturn conjunct Rahu
strength_assessment.strong: Saturn tightly conjunct Rahu in a dusthana or on Lagna/Moon

yogas.effects: A curse-like pattern of repeated delay and obstruction; karmic in flavour. Frame as a karmic lesson with effort-based resolution, never as an irreversible curse.

yogas.name: Paap Kartari Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: malefics flanking but one is mild or benefic-aspected
strength_assessment.medium: malefics in both flanking houses of the target house
strength_assessment.strong: strong malefics tightly flanking, no benefic relief

yogas.effects: The hemmed house is squeezed and weakened — its significations struggle.
negation_conditions: benefic in or aspecting the hemmed house

yogas.name: Shubha Kartari Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: benefics flanking but mild
strength_assessment.medium: benefics in both flanking houses of the target house
strength_assessment.strong: strong benefics tightly flanking the house

yogas.effects: The hemmed house is protected and supported — its significations flourish.

yogas.name: Moksha Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: Ketu in 12th alone
strength_assessment.medium: Jupiter or Ketu in 12th, or a moksha-trikona lord in 12th
strength_assessment.strong: Jupiter + Ketu together in 12th, or multiple 5/9/12 lords in the 12th

yogas.effects: Inclination toward liberation, surrender, detachment, monastic or contemplative life.
negation_conditions: strong malefic worldly pull from 10th/11th lords on the 12th

yogas.name: Pravrajya Yoga

strength_assessment.weak: 4 planets in one sign
strength_assessment.medium: 4 planets in one sign including a dispositor link
strength_assessment.strong: 4+ planets in one sign, one of them the dispositor of the rest

yogas.effects: Renunciation, asceticism, a strong pull away from worldly life.
negation_conditions: strong benefic worldly yogas dominating the chart
